messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: `PD#24567` - Redis maxclients & Postgres connection surge detected in prod (us-east-1). Auto-escalation to eng-oncall.
pagerduty-bot: Paging sam (primary oncall). Severity: P1. Acknowledgement window started. See: https://pd.example.com/incidents/24567
maria: acked. looking at dashboards now. seeing Redis maxclients at 100% and pgbouncer queue growth. pg connections spiking too.
sam: on it. rough timeline? any customer-facing errors? get probe data pls.
alex: graphs show a traffic ramp from a marketing campaign starting ~5m ago. 90th latency for redis up to 600ms, errors increasing (ERR max clients). pg waiting connection count rising.
anita: putting temporary rate-limit on public inference route to shed load: `nginx: /v1/generate` -> limit_req zone=fast 10r/s
leo: starting a quick pgbouncer scale, spinning 2 more pgbouncer pods in k8s (replicas +2). patch command:
```
kubectl scale deployment/pgbouncer --replicas=6 -n platform
```
maria: also bumping redis replicas? this is a managed redis cluster (elasticache) - can't change maxclients quickly. but we can evict ephemeral KV prefixes and enable prefix caching fallback.
sam: priority mitigation: 1) reduce incoming QPS via rate-limit + backoff headers to clients, 2) scale pgbouncer, 3) enable redis LRU eviction for non-critical keys, 4) fail open to read-replicas for some queries.
alex: rolling out rate-limit now. deployed config to edge. `deploy: edge-rate-limit v2026.03.14-rl1` - will take 30s to propagate.
anita: added temporary 503 with Retry-After header for non-auth requests exceeding threshold. pinging infra to approve.
incident-bot: sam acknowledged at 3209876558. auto-escalation timer paused. Next escalation to lead after 10m if not resolved.
leo: pgbouncer pods are up. seeing connection queue drop ~40% in the last 60s. some pg queries still queued but healthy fit.
maria: Redis maxclients still at 100% but served QPS dropped ~35% after rate-limit. errors trending down slightly.
sam: good. any long-running queries causing pg conn hold? run `SELECT pid, now() - pg_stat_activity.query_start AS duration, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active' ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 10;`
alex: ran that; a batch job kept 6 long transactions open for 3-4m. killing the top 2 transactions freed connections. `select pg_terminate_backend(pid)` used.
anita: killing long jobs reduced pg waiters. pushing a slow-query alert to the team owning the batch job to fix scheduling.
maria: rolling a small config change on Redis client to use `maxclients_per_connection: 50` and enable exponential reconnect jitter. pushing out in 2m.
sam: monitoring SLOs and customer impact. Currently some 502/503s on inference -> map to degraded quality for certain customer requests. Noting impacted tenants: tenant-42, tenant-77. CS looped in.
leo: running `redis-cli info clients` shows stale idle clients from older workers. killing those sockets helped drop count by ~120.
alex: infra: autoscaling for worker pool triggered slower than expected; filing infra ticket to improve scale policy. for now we manually scaled worker deployment by +3.
anita: quick playbook note added: when redis maxclients triggers, try client socket prune + temp rate-limit + pgbouncer scale first.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: Incident status -> acknowledged (sam). Notes appended.
sam: handing off to anita for maintenance window and follow-up. I'm going offline in 15m, will monitor but handoff now. anita take lead.
anita: ack taking lead. will coordinate postmortem and customer comms. keeping page open until stable for 30m.
maria: metrics now: redis errors down to baseline 5% over 10m window, pg queued connections at acceptable levels. continuing to watch.
leo: executed a deploy to add more connection pooling to app side (conn reuse improvements). patch id: `connpool-optim-20260314`.
anita: documenting mitigation timeline in internal incident doc. creating ticket INC-2026-24567 for follow-ups: improve redis client pooling, make pgbouncer autoscale faster, add circuit-breakers on hot routes.
sam: adding a note: consider setting Redis `maxclients` early warning alert at 80% instead of current 95%.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: manual resolve still required. anita please update when resolved.
anita: marking this thread for handover to oncall review. closing page in 35m if metrics stable. sending summary to #postmortems after closure.
maria: quick customer note: CS sent outbound to tenant-42 with workaround guidance. will follow up with postmortem link.
leo: final check: no replication lag, no OOM. redis memory healthy. I think we can de-escalate in 20m.
anita: thanks everyone. handing to next-day oncall for follow-ups. will post a short blameless timeline and action items.
sam: back briefly: great work. 👍
incident-bot: Last update appended at 3209876745."
